compose-config.description: Validate the Docker Compose file without starting anything. Part of lint-code, so the Lint leg of continuous-integration.yml runs it. Requires docker compose. Creates the workspace-root .env from .env.default when it is missing (the documented bootstrap; .env is gitignored) and never touches an existing one. Uncached on purpose: the compose file reads the workspace-root .env (env_file), which is gitignored and so cannot be declared as an input, and a cached pass would replay after .env goes missing or changes.

helm-lint.description: Lint the kubernetes-job Helm chart against its base values. Part of lint-code, so the Lint leg of continuous-integration.yml runs it. Requires helm on PATH (the devcontainer installs it; the GitHub-hosted runners ship it).

open-webui.description: Manage the Open WebUI Docker service (up, down, open)

recreate.command: docker compose -f {projectRoot}/docker/docker-compose.yml down -v postgres && docker compose -f {projectRoot}/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres

postgres.description: Start, stop, or recreate the local PostgreSQL container (recreate removes the volume)

searxng.description: Manage the SearxNG Docker service (up, down, open)

terraform-apply.description: Apply a Terraform root (--configuration=openrouter, github, or linode), creating, updating, and deleting what a fresh plan finds. Needs the terraform-plan variables. Run by the Continuous Deployment workflow on main; run it locally only on purpose.

terraform-format.description: Check that the OpenRouter, GitHub, and Linode Terraform is formatted. Part of lint-code. Requires terraform on PATH (the devcontainer installs it; CI uses hashicorp/setup-terraform).

terraform-init.description: Initialize a Terraform root (--configuration=openrouter, github, or linode) against its Linode Object Storage backend. Needs TF_STATE_BUCKET, AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.

terraform-plan.description: Plan a Terraform root (--configuration=openrouter, github, or linode) and write plan.tfplan beside it, without changing anything. Needs the terraform-init variables plus TF_VAR_openrouter_management_key.

terraform-validate.description: Validate the OpenRouter, GitHub, and Linode Terraform without a backend or credentials. Part of lint-code. Requires terraform on PATH and downloads the provider, so it needs network access.

options.command: for module in openrouter github linode; do (cd $module && terraform init -input=false -backend=false && terraform validate) || exit 1; done

trivy-config.description: Scan Terraform infrastructure code for misconfigurations using Trivy. Identical to what the Secure Code workflow runs, so a local run reproduces CI exactly. Requires trivy on PATH (the devcontainer installs it; otherwise `brew install trivy`).
